errors.possibleCors: Request failed: the endpoint may not allow browser cross-origin (CORS) requests, or the network is unreachable. If CORS is the cause, consider using LLM Gate instead.

400.solution: Fix the request body as described in the server response

401.solution: Check that your API key is correct and filled in; if you do not have one yet, create it on your provider's API Keys page

402.solution: Check your account balance and top up on your provider's billing page

422.solution: Fix the parameters as described in the server response; a wrong model ID is the usual cause

429.solution: Slow down your request rate and retry later

500.solution: Wait and retry; if the problem persists, contact your provider

other.reason: The endpoint returned an error status
other.solution: Check that the Base URL, model ID and API key are correct

setup.title: Welcome to SimpleChat
setup.description: SimpleChat is a pure frontend application with all data stored in your browser. To interact with AI models, you need to configure your own LLM interface.

deepseek.step1: Step 1: Sign up and get an API Key
deepseek.step1Description: Go to the DeepSeek platform, create an account, top up your balance, and create an API Key on the API Keys page.

api.notice: In API mode your browser talks to the provider you enter directly, so that provider has to allow cross-origin (CORS) requests — every major provider does. If you are unsure, fill in the fields and test it; if requests keep failing, switch to LLM Gate mode.
api.baseUrlDescription: Usually ends with /v1. SimpleChat appends /chat/completions automatically — do not add it yourself.
api.baseUrlRequired: Pick a provider, or enter a custom Base URL
api.apiKeyDescription: Stored only in your browser; leave empty for local endpoints without auth. The key is sent straight from your browser to the provider you enter — it never passes through any relay.
api.modelsEmpty: The endpoint returned an empty model list.
api.modelsFailed: Failed to fetch the model list.
api.modelIdRequired: Select a model, or enter the model ID manually
api.modelIdDescription: Sent as the `model` field in requests; must match the provider's documentation.
api.noModelInfo: This endpoint returned no extra info for the model.

setup.step1: Step 1: Download and Install LLM Gate
setup.step1Description: LLM Gate is a local LLM API gateway that supports Windows and macOS. It provides SimpleChat with the interface to communicate with AI models.
setup.step2: Step 2: Configure a Model in LLM Gate
setup.step2Description: Open the LLM Gate software and use the 'Quick Add Wizard' to configure your desired AI model. After configuration, return to the home page and copy the model's Base URL.
setup.setupSuccess: Setup successful! You can now start chatting.

api.title: API Settings
api.contextLengthDescription: Controls how many conversation rounds are sent to the AI. Longer context helps AI remember earlier conversations, but consumes more tokens and may exceed the model's context window limit. Start with standard setting.

models.title: Model Management
models.manageDescription: Configure and manage AI models for conversations
models.addDescription: Pick a provider and fill in the endpoint; the model is appended to the list and your default model stays unchanged.
models.modelUrlDescription: Usually ends with /v1. SimpleChat appends /chat/completions automatically — do not add it yourself.
models.modelIdDescription: Sent as the `model` field in requests; must match the provider's documentation
models.apiKeyDescription: Stored only in your browser; leave empty for local endpoints without auth. The key is sent straight from your browser to the provider you enter — it never passes through any relay.
models.gateHint: With LLM Gate, the model is determined by the ID in the URL, so no model ID or API Key is needed here.
models.modelNameDescription: Display name only, not used for API calls
models.confirmDeleteDescription: Conversations using this model will switch to the default model.

data.title: Data Management
data.clearAllDataDescription: Delete all conversations and settings. This action cannot be undone.
data.confirmClearAllDescription: This will permanently delete all conversations and settings. This action cannot be undone.

chat.title: Chat
chat.systemPromptPlaceholder: e.g., You are a professional programming assistant who excels at answering technical questions...
chat.systemPromptDescription: The system prompt defines the AI's role and behavior. It is saved independently for each conversation, unaffected by context length limits, and is always sent to the AI model.
chat.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this conversation?

errors.noModel: No model available, please add a model in settings
errors.noGateway: Please configure the gateway URL in settings first
